Setup checklist - all three are required
Lets the SM bubble float above the game
Lets the bot read and tap the spin button

Settings, counters, log lines and calibration points are cleared.

This bot never touches the Jaiho 777 APK. The game is not modified, not repackaged and not bundled. Sanjoy Money only reads the screen through Accessibility and taps like a fast finger. No root, no VPN, no proxy, no server. The bot has its own package (com.sanjoymoney.jaiho) so it installs next to the real game instead of replacing it.

1. Open Jaiho 777 through the home screen.
2. Open the SM panel and tap the crosshair button.
3. Drag the SPIN crosshair onto the real spin button and the COLLECT crosshair onto the real collect or claim button.
4. Save. The points are stored as screen percentages and are used whenever Accessibility cannot find the buttons.
Start the bubble from the home screen to calibrate over the game

Drag the gold SPIN crosshair onto the real spin button and the green COLLECT crosshair onto the collect or claim button, then save. Taps only fall back to these points when Accessibility cannot find the button.
